exam_rules: Online proctored exam via Kryterion Webassessor. Closed book. No notes, calculators, or external resources. Webcam monitoring throughout. Exam session is recorded.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID (passport, driving licence, national ID); webcam and microphone required for online proctoring via Kryterion

lifecycle.summary: Zendesk still sells this exam: 'Certification: Zendesk Explore CX analyst expert exam Get Certified in Zendesk's reporting & analytics solution, Explore. Purchase | $350', with 'Format: 72 multiple choice questions Time allotted: 90 minutes Passing score: 69% Exam fee: USD $350 Delivery Options: Online in a proctored environment'. Zendesk's certification catalogue lists it as 'Explore CX Analyst Expert Configure and manage your reporting like a guru.' No retirement wording appears.

prerequisites.description: Recommended: hands-on experience with Zendesk Explore; completion of Zendesk Explore training

renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years; renewal requires re-examination at current exam fee ($299)

retake_policy.notes: One free retake included with each exam purchase after 7-day waiting period; subsequent retakes require full repurchase at $299
